name: GhostTreeTrigger
description: Non-focusable row or disclosure target (default <span>, no role or tabindex) inside GhostTreeItem, so the tree has no nested interactive controls. action="both" selects and toggles (with expandOnClick), "toggle" only toggles expansion, "select" only selects. Non-toggle triggers label the item through aria-labelledby; focus() delegates to the owning item.

props.name: action
props.description: Pointer click behavior: select and toggle, toggle only, or select only.

props.name: as
props.description: Tag name or component for the non-focusable row or disclosure target.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Local disable flag, combined with the item and root `disabled`.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Visible label and decorative (aria-hidden) affordances such as a chevron.

parts.name: trigger
parts.description: Row or disclosure target rendered by GhostTreeTrigger.

attributes.name: data-selected
attributes.description: Present while the owning item is selected.

attributes.name: data-disabled
attributes.description: Present when the trigger, its item, or the tree is disabled.

keyboard.Enter: Handled by the owning treeitem; the trigger itself is never focused.

spec.evidence: Direction (Option A) approved by Zac (maintainer) in chat on 2026-11-17; recorded in the GHO-105 Linear document and the "Approval and readiness update - November 17, 2026" note on GHO-105. See the Status line in this spec.
